paras: Upgrade your Honda Civic Type R's front braking performance with Dixcel brake rotors, engineered in Japan and developed through decades of OEM supply and motorsport experience. Dixcel rotors are designed to deliver consistent braking performance, stable pedal feel, and reliable control for daily driving through to more spirited use.

This listing covers the Dixcel brake rotor types shown for the Honda Civic Type R FK8 (2017-2021) and FL5 (2022+) platforms fitted with 350x32mm front disc brakes . Both generations are powered by the 2.0L K20C1 turbocharged DOHC VTEC engine. Multiple rotor types are available, ranging from street-focused replacements to higher-performance applications. Use the product options on this page to select the rotor type best suited to your driving style and vehicle configuration.
hl: PD Type (Daily / Street): Standard replacement rotor with an anti-rust coating.
SD Type (Daily / Street): Six offset slits for up to 20% more braking power than a plain rotor.
FP Type (Spirited / Track Day): Plain, heat-treated high-carbon rotor (around 20% more carbon) for improved crack resistance.
FS Type (Spirited / Track Day): Slotted, heat-treated high-carbon rotor for stronger initial bite under hard use.
